purpose: Static table-model parallelism acceptance; this manifest separates executable static paths from the hash-repartition work still required for grouped aggregation and joins.

cases.acceptance: Retain DOP=1 versus DOP>1 result-equivalence reports and normal-query metrics. A lower latency is a measurement, not a predeclared result.
This is an end-to-end downstream-cost control. Its plan must be retained because a computed project may take the safe serial fallback.
The enabled plan must expose the reviewed TableMergeSortOperator marker and the fallback must preserve the complete row sequence.
Retain EXPLAIN and results at every DOP as a global-order control. Do not report a scan-parallel speedup for this family unless a later reviewed plan proves a complete global Top-K implementation.
The enabled -morsel- plan and morsel-disabled fallback must return the same row multiset; retain per-driver observed wall time and LPT/equal-count evidence.

Collect a DOP=1 result and plan as a semantic baseline only. Partitioned(groupKeys), key shuffle, and a group-by acceleration claim remain prohibited until the real hash exchange is wired and accepted.
Collect a DOP=1 result and plan as a semantic baseline only. Co-partitioned join, key shuffle, and a join acceleration claim remain prohibited until the real hash exchange is wired and accepted.
